articles.title: Bitcoin-backed mortgages are coming to Canada, but borrowers are still unaware of the cost
articles.summary: Prospective borrowers face collateral liquidation risks if bitcoin prices drop, though APX said property and crypto collateral will be handled distinctly.

articles.title: CFTC chief poses questions about policing AI but calls it a road to 'autonomous trading'
articles.summary: The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission held a forum in which the chairman, Mike Selig, suggested AI agents may usher in a financial revolution.

articles.title: Crypto isn’t a partisan fight, proven by data
articles.summary: Treating crypto as a political battleground only makes it harder to build the secure, transparent, American-made financial system that most Americans say they want, argues DeFi Education Fund’s Jennifer Rosenthal.
